events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with four scenarios for geopolitics after the war. The US is showing military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power. The Middle East is a powder keg with geopolitical instability and strategic rivalries.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will lead to increased defense spending and a potential boost to the aerospace and defense sector. On the other hand, the oil services sector may suffer due to the potential disruption of oil supplies.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict de-escalates or when the ETFs reach their target prices.
